info.title: Brillianda API
info.description: Multi-tenant school registry API. The school is resolved from the request host; call it through the frontend's /api rewrite. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json); see docs/api-conventions.md.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Switch on this.

requestId.description: Quote this when reporting a problem.

errors.description: validation_failed only: one entry per field.

reason.description: verification_failed: invalid | expired | too_many_attempts. subdomain_unavailable: taken | reserved | invalid.

nextStep.description: signup_incomplete only: the step to do first.

existingAccount.description: The verified email already has a Brillianda account; step 4 needs its password

codeSentTo.description: Masked email the last code went to

turnstileToken.description: Cloudflare Turnstile response from the widget

handoverUrl.description: Open within 60 seconds; the school's address exchanges it for a session

existingPassword.description: Only when the draft says existingAccount: the password of that Brillianda account

existingAccount.description: true: just accept. false: also send fullName and password

get.summary: Public branding for the school at this address
The signed-in user and their role in this school

401.description: Not signed in to this school

post.summary: Sign out of this school on this device
post.description: Always clears the cookie and returns 204, whether or not the session was still valid.

get.summary: Is this school address available? If not, why, and what is
The signup in progress in this browser, to resume where it stopped

post.summary: Step 1: school details. Starts a signup, or updates the one in progress
Step 2: the owner's account. Sends a 6-digit code to the email
Step 3: send a new code (available 60 seconds after the last one)

200.description: Sent, or still cooling down (see resendAvailableInSec)

post.summary: Step 3: the 6-digit code (5 attempts, expires after 10 minutes)

400.description: Wrong, expired or exhausted code (see reason)

post.summary: Step 4: choose the address. Creates the school and its owner in one transaction

409.description: Address unavailable, or earlier step missing

post.summary: Sign in with email and password on this school's address

200.description: Signed in; the session cookie is set

401.description: Email or password is incorrect (also when not a member of this school)

post.summary: Exchange the 60-second signup handover token for a session on the new school's address

200.description: Signed in; the session cookie is set

post.summary: Email a one-time sign-in link for this school (15 minutes)

202.description: Accepted. The same answer whether or not the email has an account

post.summary: Sign in with the token from a magic link

200.description: Signed in; the session cookie is set

post.summary: Email a password reset link for this school (30 minutes)

202.description: Accepted. The same answer whether or not the email has an account

post.summary: Set a new password with the reset token. Signs out every other device in every school

200.description: Signed in; the session cookie is set

post.summary: Email links to every school this address can sign in to (main site only)

202.description: Accepted. The same answer whether or not the email has an account
